content_sections.heading: About Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Tuljapur
content_sections.text: Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Tuljapur is located on Latur Road, Tuljapur in Dharashiv district, Maharashtra, and functions under Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth, Parbhani, an agricultural university. The SRF will work under the National Innovations in Climate Resilient Agriculture (NICRA) Project run at this Kendra. The notification is issued by the Nodal Officer & Programme Coordinator, Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Tuljapur.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master's degree in Agronomy/ Soil and Water Conservation Engineering from a recognized university. Proficiency in ICT tools, MS Office, document editing and presentation software. Skills in field-level data collection, field surveys and experimental observations. Skills in research data compilation, analysis, documentation, technical reporting and project handling. The notification states: "Maximum age is 35 years". The application form asks for the age as on the last date of application. Candidates who do not fulfil the minimum qualifications will not be allowed for the interview. For the full eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) are Rs. 37000/- per month + HRA. The rate of HRA is not specified in the notice. The appointment is purely on contract basis. The incumbent has no legal right to claim regularization or appointment by absorption against any regular post, or any further contractual engagement, on termination of the scheme/project. The appointment is full time. The incumbent will not be allowed to do any other work or to accept or hold another appointment, with or without remuneration, elsewhere. The selected candidate must join within seven days from the date of issue of the order, failing which the order will be treated as cancelled. The selected candidate has to give an undertaking on stamp paper of Rs. 100/- not to leave the assignment halfway and to complete the target in the prescribed time limit. To leave, one month's advance notice in writing is needed; otherwise one month's salary has to be deposited. Temporary technical manpower does not have the status of a regular employee and is not entitled to any regular leave. Leave and other benefits will be as per the existing norms of the University. No accommodation will be provided. The incumbent is liable for discontinuation at any time without notice on account of unsatisfactory work or any other valid grounds. The length of the engagement is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for VNMKV Senior Research Fellow (SRF)
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format enclosed with the notification (application form on pages 3 and 4), giving full details. Affix a latest passport size photograph on the form. Attach self-attested photocopies of certificates/documents. For publications, give the number in the form and attach a separate list with copies of the full-length papers. Sign the declaration and write the e-mail and mobile number correctly, because further correspondence will be by e-mail, SMS or WA message only. Send the application by post or submit it in person to: Programme Co-ordinator, Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Latur Road, Tuljapur–413 601, Dist. Dharashiv, Maharashtra. Make sure the application reaches on or before 30 November 2026 up to 5:00 pm. Postal delay or late applications for any reason will not be considered. Applications submitted online will not be considered. Incomplete forms will be rejected, and all documentary evidence should be readable and clear.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Based on the scrutiny committee report, candidates will be shortlisted for interview in a 1:5 ratio. If the number of applications is large, candidates will be shortlisted on merit based on academic performance/publications/experience etc. Only shortlisted eligible candidates will be interviewed by the selection committee. The date and venue of the interview will be communicated to shortlisted candidates through e-mail only. Candidates must report at the institute one hour before the scheduled date and time with all original documents for verification. No TA/DA will be provided for appearing for the interview. Original documents of date of birth. Original documents of educational qualifications (SSC and above). Reprints of research papers published. Experience certificates. No Objection Certificate, if employed. Two sets of Xerox copies and two passport size photos.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the VNMKV SRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is One (01) Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post under the NICRA Project at Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Tuljapur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the KVK Tuljapur SRF post?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Programme Co-ordinator, Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Tuljapur on or before 30 November 2026 up to 5:00 pm; late applications, including postal delay, will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the VNMKV SRF post?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Agronomy/ Soil and Water Conservation Engineering from a recognized university is essential. Skills in ICT tools, MS Office, field-level data collection, data analysis and technical reporting are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the KVK Tuljapur SRF post?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years, with a relaxation of five years for SC/ST and women and three years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the VNMKV Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs. 37000/- per month + HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the SRF pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notification gives the pay as Rs. 37000/- per month + HRA. It also states that no accommodation will be provided and no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the VNMKV SRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the enclosed application format, attach self-attested copies of certificates/documents and a passport photo, and send it by post or submit it in person to Programme Co-ordinator, Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Latur Road, Tuljapur–413 601, Dist. Dharashiv, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply online for the KVK Tuljapur SRF post?
faq.answer: No. The notification states that applications submitted online will not be considered; only hard copies sent by post or submitted in person are accepted.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the VNMKV SRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted in a 1:5 ratio on the scrutiny committee report, on merit based on academic performance/publications/experience, and then interviewed by the selection committee. The interview date and venue will be sent to shortlisted candidates by e-mail only.

faq.question: Q10. Is the VNMKV SRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely on contract basis under the NICRA Project, and the incumbent has no legal right to claim regularization or further engagement on termination of the scheme/project.
